attractions.name: Devaraja Market
attractions.description: Bustling local market with turmeric, kumkum powders, jasmine garlands, sandalwood, fresh produce and traditional Mysore sweets.

attractions.name: Brindavan Gardens
attractions.description: Terraced gardens at KRS Dam set against the Krishnaraja Sagar reservoir, with symmetrical lawns and water channels. Illuminated at dusk, with a musical fountain show of water jets set to music and colored lights.
attractions.hours: 6:00 AM – 8:00 PM; Musical Fountain approx. 6:30 PM – 7:30 PM
tips: Visit at dusk for the illuminations and musical fountain show

attractions.name: Chamundi Hills & Chamundeshwari Temple
attractions.description: Hilltop temple with sweeping views of Mysore city, reached by a scenic drive.

tips: Morning visit is calm with a pleasant breeze

tips: Interiors glow beautifully in late morning light, good for photography
